A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc at the bottom right, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 17 August 2019. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older than its first saved copy.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-attackrun-PC-Errata-2019-disc-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Attack Run (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (8 July 2018): The game text changes: “Trench” becomes “trench”; “+X +Y -Z)” becomes “+ X + Y - Z)”; “"blown away."” becomes “'blown away.'”; “(or” becomes “or”; “aboard) just before Pull Up!.” becomes “is present.”; “opponent's” is removed; “Trench just before Pull Up!.” becomes “trench.”. Another full card image (350 × 490 pixels): the text box is set again, and a small round bronze disc at the lower right replaces the white “E”.

The whole 2018 E card image and the whole 2019 disc card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
